# Report

## Load and import data
```{r load library, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom) #for aesthetic clean tables
library(writexl)
library(ResourceSelection) # for hosmer-lemeshow test
library(car) #for multicollinearity
library(gtsummary)
```

```{r import data, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/torra034-svg/biostats/refs/heads/main/Biostats%202/Data%20Stuff/dekaf_dgf.csv"

dekaf <- read.csv(url)
```

```{r remove url, echo=FALSE}

rm(url)

```

## Dataset Data Cleaning
```{r create Cardiac Death variable}

dekaf <- dekaf %>% 
  mutate(cardiac_death = if_else(dcd_yn == 1, "Yes", "No", missing = NULL))

```

## Exploratory Data Analysis
```{r table 1 - group by dgf}
table_1 <-dekaf %>% 
  mutate(Race = if_else(raceblack == 1, "African American", "Other", missing = NULL),
         Gender = if_else(gender == 1, "Male", "Female", missing = NULL),
         Delayed_Graft_Function = if_else(dgf == 1, "Yes", "No", missing = NULL)) %>% 
  select(Race, Gender, Delayed_Graft_Function, cardiac_death) %>%  
  tbl_summary(by = Delayed_Graft_Function,
              label = list(cardiac_death ~ "Cardiac Death")) %>% 
  modify_caption(caption = "**Table 1. Participant Demographics**") %>% 
  modify_header(label ~ "**Delayed Graft Function**")
  
  ## gender, race, cardiac after death

table_1
```
